title.narrative: Strengthening community resilience and regional demining capacity

description.narrative: This 18-month exceptional assistance measure aims to pilot concrete measures in Palestinian camps to improve conditions and governance beyond ongoing service provision, testing different models to extend access and certain rights and opportunities for Palestinians in close coordination with the Lebanese authorities (such as the Lebanese Palestinian Dialogue Committee) and within the strict security boundaries imposed by the Lebanese Armed Forces and other security agencies. It should ultimately contribute to mitigate instability while paving the way for longer term governance solutions in the camps.In parallel, this measure will support the Regional School for Humanitarian Demining in Lebanon operating under the Lebanon Mine Action Center (LMAC) by upgrading facilities, developing the curriculum, and delivering training and exchanges on best practices in humanitarian demining. The upgraded facilities will enhance national, regional, and international mine-action capacity by providing modern training, accommodation, and coordination facilities. Completing the School¿s infrastructure and strengthening its training programmes directly supports national capacity while addressing a critical regional training gap.
